item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 31/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The weather will still be cold over the region. With the monsoon moderating gradually, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Meanwhile, a dry easterly airstream will affect the coast of southeastern China. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be warm during the day.

Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
